meta.title: Dallas County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Dallas County's 2026 budget as passed by the quorum court on November 20, 2025, in two appropriation ordinances: 2025-25 for County General and 2025-24 for the other funds. It is a scanned copy, and we use the amounts written into those ordinances. The ordinances list repair and maintenance supplies as their own line, so we show them as their own category.

nodes.name: County General
nodes.note: Printed grand total is $4,558,019.91; the department totals listed add to $4,558,099.91. The $80 gap matches Equalization Board, whose printed total is $80 more than its own lines.

nodes.name: Equalization Board
nodes.note: Printed total is $103,199.00; the categories listed add to $103,119.00.

nodes.name: Jail
nodes.note: Printed total is $1,617,676.05; the categories listed add to $1,617,716.05.

nodes.name: Grants in Aid
nodes.note: Eight grants (soil conservation, regional planning district, Association of Arkansas Counties, Fordyce chamber, Red Cross, animal rescue, county fair, county museum); they add to this total.
